title: September 2025: LaTeX support, OneDrive integration, and Sparky can edit images!
summary: Flint’s September update adds LaTeX math support, OneDrive integration, and AI image editing, making teaching simpler and smarter.
body_markdown:
Our September updates are now live! Check out what we’ve added to Flint over the last few weeks.


## ➗ LateX document support + clean exporting


Teachers can now add beautifully formatted equations into their documents with built-in LaTeX support.


-


Click the equation icon to write with LaTeX directly in Flint.


-


Export equations to Word or Google Docs with perfect formatting.


-


Use **compact mode** to shrink the calculator into a draggable window—perfect for multitasking while you create worksheets and lessons.


## 📂 OneDrive integration


Microsoft schools, we’ve got you covered. Flint now integrates with **OneDrive** , so you can:


-


Import lesson plans, worksheets, and teaching materials straight from your OneDrive.


-


Enjoy the same seamless experience as our Google Drive integration.


-


Keep all your resources, whether that's Google or Microsoft, in one place inside Flint.


## 🖼️ Edit images with Sparky


Your AI teaching assistant just got more creative. You can now:


-


Upload any picture or classroom image.


-


Ask Sparky to make edits to your image.


-


Spark fun seasonal activities or create visuals that fit your lesson needs.


## ✨ Bonus updates: group organization + customization!


We’ve added new ways to stay organized:


-


**Unpublished Groups** let you draft or archive without clutter.


-


**Duplicate or Move Activities** across workspaces in just a few clicks.


For admins, updating group settings is simpler than ever. And with SIS/LMS integration, you can now set **default status and visibility** for groups automatically.
